kids: 🎓 Starlane tours rebuilt: 17 longer lessons, Nova talks you through each step, and you can see the real keyboard and mouse being used
🛬 A proper docking lesson — approach from the side, level the slot, then let the docking computer do it
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: tours rebuilt — each step waits for Nova to finish speaking (with a timed fallback), movies stay on, Modern controls steer with the mouse pointer, and a realistic keyboard and mouse light up as they are used. New docking lesson (off-angle approach, levelling and spin-matching, then the docking computer) and five new tours: your cockpit, sitting in the station, rescues and surveys, police and the law, saving and settings. Ending a tour returns you to where you started it. Fixed: fuel scoops were missing from the Shipyard categories.

kids: 🛒 Starlane: a bigger shipyard with pages — and new gear: Starburst laser (5), fire-control computer (6), plasma cannon, twin beams, shield booster, repair drones, tractor beam and afterburner
🖥️ Movies, rear and side views now fill a widescreen too
🔢 Nova says numbers like 6.2 properly
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Shipyard categories (Essentials, Weapons, Defence, Systems) with automatic pages and a description of each item; the Market pages automatically as goods are added. New: twin beam and plasma lasers, Starburst laser charges, shield booster, fire-control computer, repair drones, tractor beam, afterburner. After being destroyed you restart at the station where you last docked. Movies, the rear/side views and the outside camera use the full widescreen; ships in movies show their full detail.
🔊 Speech: numbers with a decimal point are read as “six point two”, everywhere in the app.

kids: 💥 Starlane: you can see every hit now — shield flashes, spreading cracks and red warnings as your ship gets close to destruction
💾 Typing a save name now works properly
📋 Click a mission to read its recap
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: hits show a shield arc (blue) or hull arc (red) at the front or rear; damage builds with lost energy (cracks, smoke, sparks, flicker); staged warnings — shield low, shield down, energy low, hull critical — with Nova, alarms and an escape-capsule prompt. Save-as name is a real text box (typing P no longer pauses the game). Click a mission under “Your missions” for its recap. Supply missions now say to buy the goods elsewhere and bring them back, and suggest where.
🕹️ Arcade: keys typed into text boxes are no longer treated as game keys.

kids: 🎓 Starlane: 12 training tours — watch Nova fly while the keys and mouse light up
💾 Save your game under different names and go back to any of them
🛬 Matching the station’s spin now really works (it was turning the wrong way!)
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Save as… / Open… named saves (opening keeps the current game as “Where I was”); 12 training tours in a practice game (station screens, trading, upgrades, missions, flying, hyperspace, jump drive, lasers, missiles/ECM, mining and scooping, stars and planets, docking) with an on-screen keyboard and mouse; fixed the spin-match lock, which turned the ship the wrong way.

kids: 🪑 Starlane: sit in your normal cockpit inside the station — every control where it is in flight, looking out at the shuttle bay
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: a second way to sit in the cockpit at a station — “Cockpit: flight controls” shows the flight cockpit exactly as in flight (console screens, switch wings, mirror and side windows, widescreen in full screen) looking into the hangar. Weapons and flight systems are safe while docked; view, camera, map, missions, hold, tips and menu work; LAUNCH gives the pre-flight warning first. The pre-flight view is still there, and you can swap between them.

kids: 🪑 Starlane: sit in your cockpit inside the station — look around the hangar, check the pre-flight list and launch from there
🎬 Docking and launch movies fixed — and now with lots of different camera shots
📋 The Missions board is tidier — no more buttons on top of the title
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: “Sit in the cockpit” from the station’s Launch tab — look around (right-drag or arrow keys), Front/Left/Right/Rear/Outside views, settings, and a pre-flight check that warns about no mission, low fuel, damage, no missiles or police trouble before launch. Movies: the far camera now shows the station, all hangar cameras stay inside the hangar, the cockpit no longer appears in movies, and five outside and five hangar camera styles are mixed at random. Missions board: station services in one row under the title.

kids: 🖥️ Full screen now shows every arcade game at its true shape — no more stretched text
🪟 Starlane: your LEFT and RIGHT side windows are back
💥 You can really see damage now — sparks, cracks, flickering screens and a hull gauge
🎛️ Clearer cockpit screens and proper switches, knobs and guarded buttons
items: 🕹️ Arcade: in full screen the canvas was being stretched sideways (a height limit overrode the calculated size); every game now keeps its true shape and fits with its controls.

🚀 Starlane Trader (Modern cockpit): upright console screens and wing panels with sharp, even text; switches drawn as toggle levers, push buttons, knobs and guarded covers; live LEFT/RIGHT side windows; visible damage — red hit flash across the whole width, cabin sparks, screen glitches, canopy cracks across widescreen, Hull gauge, HULL light and warning.

kids: 🎛️ Starlane MODERN: real switches, levers and knobs on the cockpit console — flip them with the mouse!
🖥️ In full screen the console now stretches right across, with your cargo and next mission on the side screens
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader (Modern, full screen on wide displays): console wings with a Cargo screen and a Mission screen (next step), and banks of 3D switches — toggle levers that stay set, spring-back levers, guarded red switches and rotary knobs for Time and View — clickable with hover help. The arcade’s own controls move to the top corners so nothing covers the console. In a smaller window the slide-up action bar is drawn as a row of switches.

kids: 🚀 Starlane MODERN: a brand-new 3D cockpit — look around with the right mouse button and see the whole cabin!
🖥️ Your ship’s screens are now built into the console, and the action buttons slide up when you need them
🖼️ In full screen, Modern now fills your whole widescreen
📋 A Mission Log tells you where you are and exactly what to do next
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader (Modern style): an enclosed 3D cockpit (canopy, glass glare, side walls and consoles, red-alert cabin lighting, head sway); the dashboard rebuilt as live screens in the 3D console; a modern font and glass buttons; a slide-up action bar; true widescreen in full screen; the aim ring and pointer hide while looking around. New Mission Log with a recap and next step for every mission, read aloud on request, and a welcome-back recap after a break. The arcade’s “Retro screen” scanlines are skipped in Modern style.

kids: 🌌 Starlane: 8 galaxies to explore — buy a galactic hyperdrive!
🏁 Station races, 🧳 passengers and ⛏️ mining contracts
🏆 The weekly Navigator’s Cup — and when you get a puzzle wrong, you see how to work it out
✨ Glowing docking guides, a hyperspace tunnel, shield flashes and a cockpit that boots up
🔊 Every ship sounds different, and the music changes with the system
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: smoother on slower machines (fixed-step timing, quality presets, FPS counter); worked explanations after wrong answers, adaptive weak-topic practice, repair and loading-bay puzzles, weekly Navigator’s Cup; docking corridor, target arrow, hyperspace tunnel, boot-up check, news ticker, ship detail, shield bubbles and explosion lighting; per-ship engine sounds and system music moods; 8 galaxies, economy events, and passenger, mining and race missions.
